Hemagglutination Inhibition.readouts: HAI titers to A/California/7/2009, A/Perth/16/2009, and B/Brisbane/60/2008

ELISA.readouts: vaccine-specific IgA, IgG, and IgM antibody levels

Flow Cytometry.sample_type: enriched B cells and PBMC-derived cell isolates
Flow Cytometry.readouts: frequencies of naive B cells, memory B cells, plasmablasts, plasma cells, and in vitro differentiated CD27lo/CD27hi populations

ELISpot.readouts: vaccine-specific IgA, IgG, and IgM antibody-secreting cell spots/secretion rates

Bulk RNA-seq.readouts: time-varying gene expression patterns, significant genes, eigengenfunctions, plasma cell gene signature, myeloid/dendritic cell lineage-associated genes

Q-PCR.readouts: expression of B cell differentiation genes including SDC1, IGHG, XBP1, CD27, CD38, CD59, PRDM1, IRF4, IRF8, BACH2, and PAX5

Transcription profiling by array.sample_type: in vitro differentiated human B cells
Transcription profiling by array.readouts: row-normalized expression of plasma cell genes across undivided, CD27lo, and CD27hi differentiation states
